pe8:1.1: yāni cattāri jhānāni, tesaṃ jhānānaṃ imāni aṅgāni, tesaṃ aṅgānaṃ samūho assa aṅgā, ayaṃ jhānabhūmi ko visesoti assa viseso:
pe8:1.2: ime samhārā, tehi ayaṃ samudāgamo, tassa samudāgamassa ayaṃ upanisā tāya upanisāya ayaṃ bhāvanā,
pe8:1.7: tena visesena ayaṃ assādo, so kassa assādo: ājānīyajjhāyino, tassa ājānīyajjhāyino, idaṃ kallatā kosalle ṭhitajjhānaṃ anomaddiyataṃ gacchati jhānabalaṃ, jhānabale ṭhitassa ayaṃ pāramippattassa imāni jhānaṅgāni anāvilasaṅkappo paṭhame jhāne jhānaṅgāni bhāvī.
pe8:1.8: sā pīti tadanusārittāva paṭhame jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ tassaṅguno ca dhammā tadabhisannitāya ca. [?]
pe8:1.9: pīti dutiye jhāne jhānaṅgadhammatā kho pana tathā pavattassa sahagataṃ jhānaṅgadhammaṃ sasukhatāya ajjhattaṃ sampasādo dutiye jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ manosampasādanatāya tadabhisannatāya ca.
pe8:1.10: pīti dutiye jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiye jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ, cetaso ekodibhāvo tatiye jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ, upekkhā phassatā tatiye jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ, sukhaṃ tassa aṅganti ca.
pe8:1.11: cetaso ekodibhāvo catutthe jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ. upekkhā adukkhamasukhā catutthe jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ, abhinisābhūmi upekkhāsatipārisuddhi catutthe jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ,
pe8:1.12: satipārisuddhi ca anekajjhā (na) bhūmīsu jhānaṅgasamāyuttā pīti cetaso ekodibhāvo catutthe jhāne jhānaṅgaṃ.
pe8:2.2: savitakke savicāre vivekānugatā paṭhame jhāne jhānabhūmi,
pe8:2.3: avitakke avicāre ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ janitaṃ pītimanugatā dutiye jhāne jhānabhūmi.
pe8:2.5: tassa sukhadukkhasahagatā abhinīhārasahagatā catutthe jhāne jhānabhūmi,
pe8:2.9: anupassanāsahagatā kāyasaṅkhārā dhammā catutthassa jhānassa bhūmi.
pe8:3.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca pāpakehi [?] akusalehi dhammehi cittacetasikasahagatā. kāmadhātusamatikka manatāpi, ayaṃ jhānaviseso.
pe8:3.3: avitakkā ceva avicārā ca sappītikāya satisahagatāya pītisahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti,
pe8:3.5: avitakkāya bhūmiyā avicāreyeva sati anugatā upekkhāsahagatā manasikārā samudācaranti,
pe8:3.7: ca bhūmiṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ jhānaviseso.
pe8:3.8: satipārisuddhisahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti, taṃ ca bhūmiṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ jhānaviseso.
pe8:3.9: viññāṇañcāyatanasahagatāya bhūmiyaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti, taṃ ca bhūmiṃ upasampajja viharati, ayaṃ jhānaviseso. tattha katame
pe8:4.4: indriyesu guttadvāratā appicchatā sambhāro parisuddhājīvo. catunnaṃ samāpattīnaṃ sambhāro akammassa vihāritā,
pe8:4.7: kusalahetu yaṃ jhānaṃ samudayaṃ gacchati. ko ca na kutoci nekkhammappattā samudāgacchanti,
pe8:4.10: sukhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ pahānāya te ca abyāpajjatāya samudāgacchanti.
pe8:5.7: saṃvejanīye ṭhāne saṃvigassa yonisopadhānaṃ jhānassa upanisā,
pe8:6.5: upekkhābhāvanā passavanā upekkhābhāvanā apassavatā upekkhā ca ajjhupekkhā ca asubhasaññābhāvanā dukkhāpaṭipadā dandhābhiññā bhavasandhābhiññā bhavasandhānaṃ, yā chabbidhā bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā anuṭṭhitā vatthukatā yānīkatā paricitā susamāraddhā,
pe8:7.2: paṭhame jhāne saṅkhārasamannāgato eso dhammo assuto sāsavo.
pe8:7.3: sace esa dhammo ayaṃ sīlo āsannapaṭikkho ca esa dhammo kāmopaticāro samāpattīnaṃ ca sabboḷāriko esa dhammo vitakkavicāro ca,
pe8:7.4: tattha cittaṃ khoheti, kāyo cettha kilamati, kāyamhi cettha kilante cittaṃ vihaññati,
pe8:7.5: anabhinīhārakkhamo ca abhiññānaṃ, ime ādīnavā paṭhame jhāne.
pe8:8.1: dutiye jhāne ime ādīnavā: pītipharaṇasahagato ca eso dhammo, na samudācārasseti cittaṃ.
pe8:8.2: asodhayaṃ upagamo cesa dhammo. upagamiparissayo domanassapaccatthiko cesa dhammo.
pe8:8.3: tattha tattha yuttītaṃ pīti, parajjato cesa dhammo dukkaraṃ hoti, avattasantāsabhūmiparivajjayanto catusu dukkhatāsu esa dhammo anuviddhāpanasaddhāya dukkhatāya ca na palibodhadukkhatāya ca abhiññādukkhatāya ca rogadukkhatāya ca, ime ādīnavā dutiye jhāne.
pe8:9.2: upekkhāsukhasahagatāya tattha sātāvīnaṃ pañcannaṃ upekkhāsukhaṃ parivattito esa dhammo tena niccasaññitānaṃ ca, yaṃ hoti
pe8:9.3: dukkhūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ cittassa saṅkhobhataṃ upādāya sukhadukkhāya gato bhavati. sukhadukkhānugataṃ
pe8:9.5: abhiññāya sacchikiriyāsu sabbepi cete dhammā tīsu jhānasamāpattīsu catūhi ca dukkhatāhi anuviddhānaṃ sā bhayā dukkhatāya palibodhadukkhatāya ca abhiññādukkhatāya ca rogadukkhatāya ca, ime ādīnavā tatiye jhāne.
pe8:10.2: ākiñcaññāsamāpattitāvate dhammānusamāpattikā etissā ca bhūmiyaṃ sātānaṃ bālaputhujjanānaṃ anekavidhāni diṭṭhigatāni uppajjanti.
pe8:10.3: oḷārikasukhumāhi ca rūpasaññāhi anuviddhāni etāni jhānāni, sadā anudayamettājhānakalādanukalāya sādhāraṇā dukkarā ca sabbe cattāro mahāsambhārā, samudāgatāni ca etāni jhānāni aññamaññaṃ nissāya samudāgacchanti.
pe8:10.4: ettha samudāgatā ca ete dhammā na samattā honti.
pe8:10.6: nirujjhanti ca ete dhammā na upādiyanti nirujjhaṅgāni ca, etesaṃ dhammānaṃ jhānāni nimittāni na jhānanimittasaññā vokirati.
pe8:11.1: nirodhasamāpattiyā apaṭisaṅkhāya avasesasaññino ākiñcaññāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti, so nirodhasamāpattito parihāyati.
pe8:11.2: āneñjasaññino asaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākiññāyatanasahagatā manasikārā samudācaranti, taṃ ca bhūmiṃ na pajānāti, so tato parihāyati.
pe8:11.3: ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa viññāṇañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti, taṃ ca bhūmiṃ na pajānāti, so tato parihāyati.
pe8:11.7: sa kissa parihāyati, kalaṅkajjhāno kalaṅkaṃ jhāyati parisamantato jhāyati, bhindanto jhāyati, na sañjāyati, āyūhanto jhāyati, kiñci ca na paricīto jhāyati,
pe8:11.8: atividhāvanto jhāyati, atimaññanto jhāyati, kāyasaṅkhāre appaṭippassambhite jhāyati, pariyuṭṭhānassa nissaraṇaṃ ajānanto jhāyati, nīvaraṇāhibhūto jhāyati, assādappattiṃ manasikaronto. jhānassa assādo kāmarāgahetūnaṃ dhammānaṃ udayoti, niruddhaṅgāni etesaṃ dhammānaṃ jhānāni uparimā sukhūpekkhā kāmakammakilesānaṃ pahānaṃ assādo, evaṃ kho puna jhānassa assādo, mahāsambādhasampīḷite. lokasannivāse asambādhokāsoti vigamessamidaṃ jhānappahānā. ayaṃ parirodhamappalirodhalokasannivāse esaniyamidaṃ jhānaṃ anamataggasaṃsārasamāpannānaṃ sattānaṃ saṃsārappahānanānisaṃso yamidaṃ jhānassa assādo. kāyassa ajhāniyajhāyino bhavati ajhāniyajhāniyajhāyīti. aparāmasanto ajhāniyajhāyitaṃjhāyati. yāni kalaṅkajhāyino padāni tāni anumitāni paṭipakkhe jhānāni uparimā sukhūpekkhā kāmakammakilesānaṃ assādo, evaṃ kho puna jhānassa assādo mahāsambādhasampiḷite, lokasannivāse asambādhokāso vigamessamidaṃ jhānappahānā.
pe8:11.9: ayaṃ palirodhamappalirodhalokasannivāse esaniyamidaṃ jhānaṃ anamataggasaṃsārasamāpannānaṃ sattānaṃ saṃsārappahānānisaṃso, yamidaṃ jhānassa assādo kāyassa ajhāniyajhāyino bhavati
pe8:11.10: ajhāniyajhāniyajhāniyīti. aparāmasanto ajhāniyajhāyī taṃ jhāyati, yāni kalaṅkhajjhāyino padāni tāni anumitāni paṭipakkhe.
pe8:12.2: samāpattikosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ jhānavisesakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ, jhānantarikakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ, samāpattivuṭṭhānakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ, jhāne sabhāvakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ, jhāne ādīnavakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ jhāne nissaraṇakosallaṃ jhānakosallaṃ jhānaphalena upādāyakosallaṃ jhānaphalena paṭisaṅkhānaphale aparihānadhammatā nibbattijhāne ca kīḷitāvī visesabhāgiyaṃ jhānaṃ paṭilabhati
pe8:12.3: idaṃ panassāti bhavahāritā ca ārammaṇanimittagāho naabhinīhārabalaṃ, cittekaggatānimittā sugatisahitā samathabalena asaṃsīdanaṃ ca jhāne maggaphalaṃ samathaṃ pavatte samādhino upekkhā paṭipubbāparanimittāsayo paggāhino satibalaṃ taṃ pavattitānaṃ ca vipassanānaṃ samaññābale.
pe8:13.1: supāramitā mettā “kāmesu sattā kāmasaṅgasattā”ti yamhi sutte desanāya vohārena dve saccāni niddiṭṭhāni dukkhaṃ ca samudayo ca. vicayena hārena. ye saṃyojanīyesu dhammesu vajjaṃ na passanti, te oghaṃ tarissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
pe8:13.2: na tarissantīti atthi, esā yutti ca vicayo ca. idaṃ nu kissa padaṭṭhānaṃ: kāmesu sattāti: pañca kāmaguṇā taṃ kāmataṇhāya padaṭṭhānaṃ,
pe8:13.3: saṃyojane vajjamapassamānāti. avijjāya padaṭṭhānaṃ, nahijātu saṃyojanasaṅgasattā oghaṃ tareyyuṃ vipulaṃ mahantanti: upādānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe8:13.5: vatthukāmā ca kilesakāmā ca, tattha kilesakāmā kāmataṇhā, kāmataṇhāya yuttā bhavanti rūpataṇhā bhavataṇhā, lakkhaṇena hārena, saṃyojane vajjamapassamānāti: saṃyojanassa,
pe8:13.6: yo tattha chandarāgo tassa kiṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ:
pe8:13.9: iti sukhāya vedanāya gahitāya tayopi vedanā gahitā honti.
pe8:13.10: vedanākkhandhe gahite sabbe pañcakkhandhā gahitā honti.
pe8:13.11: rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabbā gahitā, vatthukāmesu gahitesu sabbāni cha bāhirāni āyatanāni gahitāni honti.
pe8:13.12: ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu yo satto ayaṃ vuccate lakkhaṇo hāro. tattha yo oḷārikamhi kilese ajjhāvasito sabbakilesesu so na tato sukhumataresu na vītarāgo bhavati.
pe8:13.15: ye oghaṃ taritukāmā te saṃyojanīyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharissantīti, ayamettha bhagavato adhippāyo,
pe8:13.16: kāmesu sattāti yesu ca sattā, yena ca sattā, yesaṃ ca sattā, ayaṃ catubabhidho ākāro sabbesaṃ hārabhāgiyo.
pe8:14.1: tattha katamāni tīṇi vipallāsāni padaṭṭhānāni ca:
pe8:14.2: cittavipallāsassa diṭṭhivipallāsassa saññāvipallāsassa tayo vipallāsā tīṇi akusalamūlāni padaṭṭhānaṃ,
pe8:14.4: catunnaṃ ca upādānānaṃ doso akusalamūlaṃ dissati,
pe8:14.6: yathā mātuyā vā pituno vā aññatarassa vā puna uḷārassa bhikkhuno abhayaṃ deti.
pe8:14.7: tattha añño micchāpaṭipajjeyya kāyena vā vācāya vā.
pe8:14.8: tattha yo byāpādamupādāya tesaṃ uḷārānaṃ rakkhāvaraṇaguttiyā anupālayanto yo uḷārānaṃ abhayaṃ deti,
pe8:14.9: tesaṃ abhaye dinne so tattha micchā paṭipajjeyya.
pe8:14.10: tattha so vyāpādaṃ upādiyanto dosajaṃ kammaṃ karoti,
pe8:14.11: yo tattha asādhu indriyā nīvaraṇaṃ yaṃ tesaṃ abhayaṃ dakkhiṇato saññaṃ idaṃ paṇītaṃ kāraṇaṃ yo puna micchāpaṭipatti ayaṃ byāpādo hīnagamīvakammaṃ lobho moho ca imāni nīvaraṇavacanāti tāni cattāri upādānāni, tehi catuhi upādānehi yo so upādāno itthi vā puriso vā tesaṃ pañcakkhandhānaṃ, teyeva upādānā samudayo, idaṃ dukkhaṃ ca samudayo ca. soyeva desanāhāro.
pe8:15.1: tattha kāmesu ye na rajjanti, te ādīnavānupassanāya pajjanti,
pe8:15.2: itissa kāmadhātuyā nikkhamitukāmatā, ayaṃ vuccati. nekkhammacchando,
pe8:15.3: yo tattha anabhisaṅkhārānaṃ kiñci visodheti tassa dhāvarā vā? ayaṃ abyāpādacchando,
pe8:15.4: kiñci na vihiṃsati, ayaṃ vihiṃsā chando
pe8:15.10: imāni tīṇi kusalamūlāni aṭṭhasu sammattesu parahitāni, tesaṃ yeva catunnaṃ upādānānaṃ nirodhāya saṃvattanti,
pe8:15.11: sace vā puna kammaṃ kareyya kaṇhaṃ vā sukkaṃ vā, tassa vipākahānāya saṃvattanti.
pe8:15.12: idaṃ kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
pe8:15.13: tattha yo tiṇṇaṃ akusalamūlānaṃ nirodho, ayaṃ nirodho,
pe8:15.14: soyeva dhammo tattha paṭipadāni, imāni dve saccāni, imāni cattāri saccāni. āvaṭṭo hāro.
pe8:16.1: “kāmesu sattā”ti ye sekkhā, te ekenevākārena sattā,
pe8:16.2: ye puthujjanā, te dvīhākārehi sattā. tatthāyaṃ pañho yo vibhajjabyākaraṇīye vattabbo.
pe8:16.3: kiñcāpi sotāpanno paṭisevati, no ca kho abhinivese satto so hi apacayāya pahadati, na upacayāya
pe8:16.6: tattha kāmesu sattānaṃ catuoghaṃ tarissatīti vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo. ayaṃ vibhatti.
pe8:17.1: ‘parivattano’ti kāme ye neva sajjanti na ca saṃyojanehi saṃyuttā, te oghaṃ tarissanti vipulaṃ mahantanta’nti.
pe8:18.1: ‘vevacana’nti yo kāmesu satto yo ca tattha kāmānaṃ guṇo tattha viso satto
pe8:18.2: yepi kāmānaṃ āhārā dhammā tattha viso satto
pe8:18.3: tatthimaṃ kāmānaṃ vevacanaṃ, paṃko rājo sallaṃ gaṇḍo īti upaddavoti.
pe8:18.4: yāni vā pana aññāni vevacanāni. tattha viso sattoti vevacanaṃ
pe8:18.5: satto bandho mucchito gathito ajjhosito kāme ajjhāpanno parimutto tabbahulavihārīti.
pe8:18.6: yāni vā pana aññāni vevacanāni, ayaṃ vevacano nāma.
pe8:18.8: satto tabbahulavihārīti yānā vā pana aññāni.
pe8:18.9: ime kāmappacārapaññattiyā kilesagocarapaññattiyā paññattā bījapaññattiyā paññattā, saṅkhārā saṃyojanapaññattiyā paññattā, upādānaṃ hetūpaññattiyā paññattaṃ, puggalo puggalapaññattiyā paññatto.
pe8:19.1: otaraṇo’ti imāya paṭiccasamuppādo dukkhaṃ ca samudayo ca.
pe8:19.2: ye kilesā ye saṅkhārā saṃyojanāni ca pañcasu khandhesu saṅkhārakkhandho dhammāyatanesu akusalā dhammāyatāni, indiyesu sukhindriyaṃ ca, somanassindriyaṃ ca. ayaṃ indiyotaraṇo:
pe8:21.1: ‘adhiṭṭhāno’ti ime dhammā atthi ekattatāya paññattā, atthi vemattatāya.
pe8:21.2: ye saññā bāhiro kāme? te vemattatāya paññattā.
pe8:21.3: pañcasu kāmaguṇesu sattāti pariyuṭṭhānavipallāsā vemattatāya paññattā. ‘oghaṃ tareyyuṃ
pe8:22.3: ayoniso ca manasikāro sannissayassa paccayatāya paccayo.
pe8:23.1: samāropano paccayo’ti ye kāmesu sattā sugatā surūpā”ti ayaṃ kāmadhātuyā chando rāgo, te apuññamayā saṅkhārā.
pe8:23.7: saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ. …pe… (yāva jarāmaraṇaṃ) evametassa kevalassa mahato dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti. (ekaṃ suttaṃ gataṃ.
pe8:24.2: yā ca abhijjhā yo ca byāpādo yaṃ ca uddhaccaṃ, ayaṃ taṇhā,
pe8:24.3: yaṃ ca thinamiddhaṃ yaṃ ca kukkuccaṃ yā ca vicikicchā, ayaṃ diṭṭhi.
pe8:24.4: yā pana kāyassa akammaniyatā kiñcāpi taṃ middhaṃ, no tu sabhāvakilesatāya kileso, iti yā ca cittasallīyanā yā ca kāyakammaniyatā ayaṃ pakkhepakileso na tu sabhāvakileso,
pe8:24.5: tattha attasaññānupacitaṃ kilamatho. kukkuccānupacitaṃ thīna, yā cittassa līyanā, iti ime pañca, nīvaraṇā cattāri nīvaraṇāni sabhāvakilesā, thīnamiddhā nīvaraṇapakkhepakileso.
pe8:24.6: yathā cattāro āsavā sabhāvaāsavatāya āsavā, no ku cittasāsavatāya āsavā
pe8:24.9: atha panāha. sukkantaṃ yena te sampayuttā vā vippayuttā vā āsavā, teyeva ete vattabbā sāsavā vā anāsavā vā.
pe8:25.3: yaṃ vā pana kiñci ajjhosānagataṃ sāsavaṃ abhijjhitassa mettānupassiya yo anatthaṃ carati,
pe8:25.4: tattha yo byāpādaṃ uppādeti, acari carissatīti.
pe8:25.5: evaṃ pana āghātavatthūni kattabbāni. tassevaṃ byāpādānupassissa kileso yo paridāho kāyakilamatho akammaniyatā middhaṃ
pe8:25.9: yaṃ yathā idaṃ santīraṇaṃ, ayaṃ vicikicchā.
pe8:25.10: tattha avijjā ca taṇhā ca atthi, idaṃ pariyuṭṭhānaṃ.
pe8:25.11: āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ chadanaṃ upakkileso ca atthi, idaṃ kāmacchando kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe8:25.19: avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ ca vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ ca diṭṭhisaṃyojanasasa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe8:26.2: kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhāne vutte sabbāni pariyuṭṭhānāni vuttāni honti,
pe8:27.2: ye ime pañca nīvaraṇājhānapaṭipakkho, so dukkhasamudayo.
pe8:28.4: yadapi bahiddhā sārajjati, tadapi nīvaraṇaṃ. evaṃ yāva vicikicchā, ime dasa nīvaraṇā.
pe8:28.5: ajjhattabahiddhā kilesā, imāni dve saṃyojanāni ajjhattasaṃyojanaṃ ca bahiddhāsaṃyojanaṃ ca.

pe8:188.14: maraṇabhavaṃ ca upapattibhavaṃ ca bhayato viditvā chandarāgaṃ pajahati.

pe8:189.1: tattha yaṃ bandhanā saṅkhārānaṃ pahānaṃ idaṃ vuccati ubhayesu ṭhānesu viriyaṃ gandhaparivāto sumuni nopalippati

pe8:189.7: yaṃ tassa pahānaṃ taṃ chedanaṃ aṭṭhakavaggiyesu muninā niddiṭṭhaṃ.

pe8:208.11: te na ca cetenti na ca patthenti na ca saṅkappenti anusayena ca saṃsaranti.

pe8:229.1: 7. 14. tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ ca nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ ca asekhabhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ:

pe8:232.4: yathā khanti ceteti ime cattāro vipallāsā. sattā yehi catubbidhaṃ attabhāvavatthuṃ rogabhūtaṃ gaṇḍabhūtaṃ ‘attā’ti vadanti.

pe8:232.7: evaṃ ‘sukha’nti ‘niccaṃ attā’ti so aññathā bhavameva santaṃ anāgataṃ bhavaṃ pattheti. tena vuccati bhavarāgo’ti
pe8:232.8: bhavamevābhinandatīti yaṃ abhinandati taṃ dukkhanti, pañcakkhandhe niddisati yaṃ
pe8:232.9: ca tappaccayā sokaparidevadukkhaṃ tassa hi bhāvessati.

pe8:233.2: sabbaso upādānānaṃ khayā natthi dukkhassa sambhavoti. cattāro vipallāsā yathā niddiṭṭhaupādānamāha.
pe8:233.3: tattha paṭhamo vipallāso kāmūpādānaṃ, dutiyaṃ diṭṭhūpādānaṃ, tatiyaṃ sīlabbatūpādānaṃ, catutthaṃ attavādūpādānaṃ. tesaṃ yo khayo natthi dukkhassa sambhavo, upadhipahānā dukkhanirodhamāha.

pe8:233.5: vibhavaṃ nābhinandatīti. dassanabhūmiṃ manteti, “sabbaso taṇhānaṃ khayā nibbāna’nti dve vimuttiyo katheti: rāgavirāgaṃ ca avijjāvirāgaṃ ca.

pe8:236.3: rāgajo dosajo mohajo diṭṭhijo ca, rāgaṃ vadāmīti attato vadati.
pe8:237.3: ye pariḷāhena na icchanti te bhavaṃ nābhinandanti.

pe8:250.9: yo sakkāyadiṭṭhinaṃ pahānāya kāmenu yathābhūtaṃ ādīnavaṃ passati,

pe8:268.6: sādhu parihāyati paro taṃ duyhati, no tu sukhaavipākinī bhavati.
pe8:268.8: tattha yo puggalo dhammānusārī, tassa yadi sotānudhatā dhammā honti, so yuñjanto pāpuṇāti.
pe8:268.9: yo dhammānusārī mudindriyo, so gilāno pāpuṇāti.
pe8:268.10: yo saddhānusārī tikkhindriyo so maraṇakālasamaye pāpuṇāti.
pe8:268.12: yadā devabhūto na pāpuṇāti, so teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā paccekabodhiṃ pāpuṇāti,

pe8:268.15: sace panassa maraṇakāle saṃviggo hoti, tattha yuñjanto pāpuṇāti.
pe8:268.16: sace pana na katthaci saṃvego hoti, tassa devabhūtassa sukhino dhammabhūtā pādā evaṃ avilapati (?)

pe8:272.2: idaṃ paṭhamaṃ saddhāpadānaṃ. ‘manasā anupekkhitā’ti paṭisallānabahulo viharati, vitthārena kātabbaṃ.
pe8:272.3: idaṃ dutiyaṃ saddhāpadānaṃ. ‘diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā’ti anāsavā cetovimutti, ‘nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī’ti
pe8:273.3: diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā’ti tathāgataṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ satthā dasseti.
pe8:275.2: imamhi sutte tayo esanā desitā, sotānudhatehi dhammehi cavasā paricitehi kāmesanāya samathamaggo.
pe8:276.1: vicayoti yathā suttaṃ manasikaronto vicinanto sutamayīpaññaṃ paṭilabhati.
pe8:276.2: yathā ca so manasikarotīti yathā sutadhammā tadā cintāmayī paññaṃ paṭilabhati.
pe8:276.3: yathā diṭṭheva dhamme manasikaroti tadā bhāvanāmayī paññaṃ paṭi labhati,
pe8:277.2: cintāya cintāmayī paññaṃ paṭilabhati, bhāvanāya bhāvanāmayī paññaṃ paṭilabhati
pe8:278.4: diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā’ti paññāyapi. (?) padaṭṭhānaṃ. (lakkhaṇoti:) (ettha lakkhaṇahāro potthakesu ūno viya dissati)
pe8:279.1: catubyuhoti: imamhi sutte bhagavato ko adhippāyo:
pe8:279.2: ye imāhi dvīhi paññāhi samannāgatā te hi…..
pe8:290.1: (āvaṭṭoti): assavanenaca amanasikārena ca appaṭivedhena ca sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā vuttā.
pe8:290.2: savanena ca manasikārena ca paṭivedhena ca sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā vuttā.
pe8:291.3: parivattanoti: ye cattāro ānisaṃsā pañcādinā paṭipakkhena (?) teneva diṭṭheva dhamme pāpuṇāti, taṃ upapajjamānā aparo pariyāyo (?)
pe8:292.1: vevacananti: sotānudhatā dhammāti yaṃ vuttaṃ diṭṭhimpi paññindriyaṃ viññātampi. diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhampi vibhavitampi?
pe8:293.1: paññattitī: sotānudhatā dhammāti desanā avijjā paññattiyā paññattaṃ,
pe8:293.2: manasikāro pāmojjapaññattiyā paññatto diṭṭhadhammāpi ānisaṃsapaññattiyā paññattā.
pe8:294.1: otaraṇoti: tisso paññā vacasā paricitesu sutamayīpaññā, manasā anupekkhitesu cintāmayīpaññā, diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhesu bhāvanāmayīpaññā,
pe8:294.2: imāni ariyasaccāni indriyāni vijjuppādā avijjānirodho paṭiccasamuppādo, indriyesu tīṇi indriyāni, āyatanesu dhammāyatanapariyāpannā, dhātusu dhammadhātupariyāpannāti.
pe8:296.1: adhiṭṭhānoti: cattāro ānisaṃsāti vemattatāya paññattā ānisaṃsā, sotānudhatāti: vemattatāya ariyavohāro paññatto dhamme ca savananti ekattatāya paññattaṃ.
pe8:297.1: parikkhāroti: dhammasavanassa payirupāsanā paccayo, saddhā hetu.
pe8:297.2: manasā anupekkhanāti. atthapaṭisaṃveditā paccayo, dhammapaṭisaṃveditā hetu. diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhāti: saddhammasavanaṃ ca manasikāro ca paccayo, sutamayī cintāmayī paññā hetu.
pe8:298.1: samāropanoti: vibhattaṃ suttaṃ, aparo pariyāyo nibbattiphale natthi.
pe8:299.1: 7. 17. tattha katamaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ ca nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ ca suttaṃ:
pe8:299.4: saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati”ti: sīlamayikapuññakiriyavatthu vuttaṃ.
pe8:299.5: “kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka”nti: lobhassa ca mohassa ca byāpādassa ca pahānamāha.
pe8:299.6: “rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto”ti: lobhassa ca mohassa ca byāpādassa ca chandarāga vinayamāhāti.
pe8:299.7: “dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī”ti alobho kusala mūlaṃ bhavati.
pe8:299.8: ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti adoso kusalamūlaṃ bhavati,
pe8:299.9: ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti averā asapattā abyāpādatāya sadā,
pe8:299.11: sa nibbuto’ti: maggaphalaṃ anupādisesaṃ ca nibbānadhātuṃ manteti. dānena oḷārikānaṃ kilesānaṃ pahānaṃ manteti. sīlena majjhimānaṃ paññāya sukhumakilesāṃ (pahānaṃ) manteti. ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti katā ca bhūmi. ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati, kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka’nti maggo vutto. ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti maggaphalamāha. ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, saṃyamato’ti tīhi padehi lokikaṃ kusalamūlaṃ vuttaṃ, rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti lokuttaraṃ kusalamūlaṃ vuttaṃ. ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati - saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti: puthujjanabhūmiṃ manteti. “kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka”nti sekhabhūmiṃ manteti. rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto”ti: asekhabhūmi vuttā. “dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati - saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī”ti: magganiyā paṭipadā vuttā. “kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka”nti: sekhavimutti. “rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto”ti: asekhavimutti. “dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati - saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī”ti: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ sagga kathaṃ lokikānaṃ dhammānaṃ desanamāha. “kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka”nti: loke ādīnavānupassanā. ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti: sāmukkaṃsikāya dhammadesanāyapi paṭividdhā. ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti: pāṇānaṃ abhayadānena pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā sattānaṃ abhayaṃ deti. evaṃ sabbāni sikkhāpadāni kātabbāni ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti: sīle patiṭṭhāya cittaṃ saṃyameti, tassa saṃyamato pāripūriṃ gacchati. ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti: dve vimuttiyo. ayaṃ suttasiddeso. tattha katamā desanā: imamhi sutte kiṃ desitaṃ: dve sugatiyo devā ca manussā ca dibbā ca pañcakāmaguṇā mānussakā ca. dvīhi padehi niddeso. ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati, kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka’nti maggo vutto. ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti dve nibbānadhātuyo desitā sopādisesā ca anupādisesā ca. ayaṃ desanā. vicayoti: ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti iminā paṭhamena padena dānamayikapuññakiriyavatthu vuttaṃ, tenassa ānantariyānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ (uppādo vutto?) dutiyena padena. … catutthena rāgadosamohakkhayena rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, mohakkhayena avijjāvirāgā paññāvimutti. ayaṃ vicayo.
pe8:300.1: yuttīti: dāne ṭhito ubhayaṃ hi paripūreti.
pe8:301.2: ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti paññādhiṭṭhānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. ‘kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka’nti saccādhiṭṭhānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
pe8:302.2: dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati.
pe8:302.3: dadatopi veraṃ na karīyati kusalo ca jahāti pāpakaṃ rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ rūpakkhayāpi vedanākkhayāpi yena rūpena diṭṭhaṃ, tena tathāgato paññāpento paññāpeyya rūpassa khayā virāganirodhāti. evaṃ pañcakkhandhā.
pe8:303.3: te dānaṃ dassanti parissayapahānāya, ye averābhicchandakā, te pañca verāni pajahissanti, ye kusalābhicchandakā, te aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessanti aṭṭhannaṃ micchattānaṃ pahānāya,
pe8:303.4: ye nibbāyitukāmā, te rāgadosamohaṃ pajahissantīti ayaṃ bhagavato adhippāyo.
pe8:304.1: āvaṭṭoti: yaṃ ca adadato macchariyaṃ yaṃ ca asaṃyamato veraṃ, yaṃ ca akusalassa pāpassa appahānaṃ, ayaṃ dukkhaniddeso na samudayo.
pe8:304.2: alobhena ca adosena ca amohena ca kusalena imāni tīṇi kusalamūlā,
pe8:304.3: tesaṃ paccayo aṭṭha sammattāni, ayaṃ maggo.
pe8:305.1: vibhattīti: ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti na ekaṃsena, yo rājadaṇḍabhayena deti, yo ca akappiyassa paribhogena sīlavantesu deti, na tassa puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatīti, so cetaṃ dānaṃ akusalena deti. daṇḍadānaṃ satthadānaṃ apuññamayaṃ pavaḍḍhati, na puññaṃ.
pe8:305.2: ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti na ekaṃsena kiṃ kāraṇaṃ: yaṃ ca yo vadhaṃ diṭṭhadhammikaṃ passati, yadi mama rājāno gahetvā hatthaṃ vā chindeyyuṃ …pe…
pe8:305.3: na tena saṃyamena veraṃ na karoti.
pe8:305.4: yo tu evaṃ samādiyati: pāṇātipātassa pāpako vipākoti. diṭṭhe yeva dhamme abhisamparāye ca evaṃ sabbassa akusalassa hetuto ārati.
pe8:306.1: parivattanoti: ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti: adadato puññaṃ na pavaḍḍhati,
pe8:306.2: yaṃ dānamayaṃ taṃ. ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti asaṃyamato veraṃ karīyati.
pe8:306.3: kusalo ca jahāti pāpakaṃ akusalo na jahāti.
pe8:306.4: ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti: … nibbuto, asekhassa natthi nibbuti. (?) [amhehi gantvāpi na bhagavā ānīto, dūtaṃ pesetvāpi na pakkosāpito, sayameva pana mahābhikkhusaṅghaparivāro amhākaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ sampatto, amhehi ca santhāgārasālā kāritā, ettha mayaṃ dasabalaṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ bhaṇāpemāti cintetvā upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pe8:306.5: ‘yena santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṃkamiṃsū’ti taṃ divasaṃ kira santhāgāre cittakammaṃ niṭṭhāpetvā aṭṭakā muttamattā honti.
pe8:306.6: buddhā nāma araññajjhāsayā araññārāmā antogāme vaseyyuṃ vā no vā’ti, tasmā bhagavato manaṃ jānitvā ca paṭijaggissāmāti cintevā te bhagavantaṃ upasaṃkamiṃsu.
pe8:306.7: idāni pana manaṃ labhitvā paṭijaggitukāmā yena santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pe8:306.8: sabbasatthari’nti yathā sabbaṃ santhataṃ hoti evaṃ, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsū’ti
pe8:306.9: ettha pana te mallarājāno santhāgāraṃ paṭījaggitvā nagaravīthiyo’pi sammajjāpetvā dhaje ussāpetvā gehadvāre puṇṇaghaṭe ca kadaliyo ca ṭhapāpetvā sakalanagaraṃ dīpamālāhi vippakiṇṇatārakaṃ viya katvā ‘khīrapake khīraṃ pāyetha, daharakumāre lahuṃ lahuṃ bhojetvā sayāpetha, uccāsaddaṃ mā karittha ajja ekarattiṃ satthā antogāme vasissati, buddhā nāma appasaddakāmā hontī’ti bheriṃ carāpetvā sayaṃ daṇḍakadīpikā ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pe8:306.10: ‘bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā’ti bhagavantaṃ purato katvā, tattha bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ ceva upāsakānaṃ ca majjhe nisinno ativiya virocati
pe8:306.11: samantapāsādiko suvaṇṇavaṇṇo abhirūpo dassanīyo. puratthimakāyato suvaṇṇavaṇṇārasmi uṭṭhahitvā asītihatthaṭṭhānaṃ gaṇhāti,
pe8:306.12: pacchimakāyato dakkhiṇahatthato vāmahatthato suvaṇṇavaṇṇā rasmiuṭṭhahitvā asītihatthaṭṭhānaṃ gaṇhāti, [upari kesantato paṭṭhāya sabbakesāmantehi moragīvavaṇṇarasmi uṭṭhahitvā gaganatale asītihatthaṭṭhānaṃ gaṇhāti]heṭṭhā pādatalehi pavāḷavaṇṇarasmi uṭṭhahitvā ghanapaṭhaviṃ asītihatthaṭṭhānaṃ gaṇhāti, evaṃ samantā asītihatthamattaṭṭhānaṃ chabbaṇṇabuddharasmiyo vijjotamānā pipphandamānā vidhāvanti sabbe disābhāgā suvaṇṇacampakapupphehi vikiriyamānā viya. suvaṇṇaghaṭato nikkhanta suvaṇṇarasadhārāhi siñcamānā viya pasārikasuvaṇṇapaṭaparikkhittā viya verambavātasamuddhuta kiṃsukakaṇikārapupphacuṇṇasamākiṇṇā viya vippakāsanti bhagavato’pi asītianubyañjanabyāmappabhādvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇasamujjalaṃ sarīraṃ samuggatatārakaṃ viya gaganatalaṃ vikasitamiva padumavanaṃ sabbaphāliphullo viya yojanasatiko pāricchattako paṭipāṭiyā ṭhapitānaṃ dvattiṃsacandānaṃ dvattiṃsasuriyānaṃ dvattiṃsacakkavattīnaṃ dvattiṃsadevarājānaṃ dvattiṃsamahābrāhmaṇaṃ [siriyā siriṃ abhibhavamānaṃ viya virocati parivāretvā nisinnabhikkhūpi sabbeva appicchā santuṭṭhā pavivittā asaṃsaṭṭhā āraddhaviriyā cattāro vacanakkhamā codakā pāpagarahino sīlasampannā samādhisampannā …pe…] (saṅgitisuttavaṇṇanā.) nibbuto asekhassa natthi nibbuti. pe8:307.1: vevacanoti: dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, anumodatopi puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati.
pe8:308.1: paññattīti: ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti alobhassa paṭinissayaghātapaññattiyā paññattaṃ.
pe8:308.2: ‘saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyatī’ti adosassa paṭinissayaghātapaññattiyā paññattaṃ. kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka’nti amohassa paṭinissayaghātapaññattiyā paññattaṃ.
pe8:309.1: otaraṇoti: pañcasu indriyesu dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati. saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati, saṃyamena sīlakkhandho
pe8:309.2: otiṇṇo, chasu indriyesu saṃvaro, ayaṃ samādhikkhandho. yaṃ kusalo ca jahāti pāpakaṃ ayaṃ paññākkhandho. rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbutoti vimuttikkhandho.
pe8:310.1: sodhanoti: yenārambhena idaṃ suttaṃ desitaṃ, so ārambho suddho.
pe8:311.2: cāgo pariccāgo dhammadānaṃ āmisadānaṃ aṭṭha dānāni vitthārena kātabbāni, ayaṃ vemattatā.
pe8:312.1: parikkhāroti: dānassa pāmojjaṃ paccayo, alobho hetu.
pe8:312.3: ‘kusalo ca jahāti pāpaka’nti yathābhūtadassanaṃ paccayo, ñāṇapaṭilābho hetu.
pe8:312.4: ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti parato ca ghoso ajjhattaṃ ca yoniso manasikāro dhammo ca hetu ca paccayo ca.
pe8:313.1: samāropanoti: ‘dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī’ti gāthā tassa sīlampi vaḍḍhati,
pe8:313.4: aññepi kilesā na cīyanti, yepissa tappaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātā, tepissa na uppajjanti.
pe8:313.5: ‘rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto’ti rāgadosassāpi khayā rāgānusayassā’pi khayā dosassa mohassāpi, ‘sa nibbuto’ti sopādisesā nibbānadhātu anupādisesāpi.
pe8:313.7: therassa mahākaccāyanassa peṭakopadese hārassa sampātabhūmi samattā.
